Only 3 race day starts where he jumped first but needs to learn to relax and be a race horse. Race fit and ready to continue. All the hard work has been done. Wormed, teeth, feet all up to date. description:
Proiser  4 year old mare very sound  but unfortunately she doesn't want to be a race horse,
As her breeding suggest she is very well breed being out of a Savabeel mare.
She would need an experienced person to handle her,  she's not nasty but has her quirks.
Bryce Newman would be happy to advise these quirks.
She is a half sister to Uncle Arch 4 wins

Spring Success is a quality daughter of champion sire Savabeel from the Group One performing mare Kays Awake (Towkay).
A good looking mare with a strong but genuine attitude toward life. She has been consistent in producing quality types with plenty of presence and athleticism.
Her first named foal, Sixteen Days (by Super Seth), is currently in our Elsdon Park racing team and is showing encouraging signs.  Spring Success is currently in foal to Ardrossan, she is a straightforward mare with plenty to offer both commercially and as a longterm breeding prospect.
Stands approximately 16hh.
LSD: 05/10/2025
Inspections welcomed.
Positive pregnancy report attached to her listing in reports section.
